facts.text: The README describes the package as trajectory optimization algorithms for continuous-control tasks simulated with MuJoCo.
The README names MuJoCo and mjrl as the main dependencies and says mujoco_py must be installed before the package is used.
The concrete environment class Reacher7DOFEnv extends mjrl's MujocoEnv and gym's EzPickle.
The constructor passes the model path curr_dir+'/assets/sawyer.xml' and the number 2 to MujocoEnv.__init__.
The environment declares observation_dim 26 and action_dim 7.
get_obs concatenates qpos, qvel, the finger site position and the finger-minus-target site difference.
step calls do_simulation(a, frame_skip), computes the reward -l1_dist - 5.0*l2_dist from the finger and target site positions, and returns False as done.
The target reset draws the target site position uniformly from x -0.3..0.3, y -0.2..0.2 and z -0.25..0.25.
reset_model resets the robot and the target and returns get_obs.
The registration comment says max_episode_steps is not used internally in trajopt; trajopt_reacher-v0 is registered with 75 and trajopt_continual_reacher-v0 with 250.
The reacher_env module imports gym.utils, mjrl.envs.mujoco_env and mujoco_py.MjViewer.
setup.py's install_requires lists click, gym, mujoco_py, termcolor, tqdm and numpy, but not mjrl.
The MJCF model is named '7dof reacher', compiles angles in radians and local coordinates, and resolves inertia from the geoms.
The model option sets timestep 0.01 s, gravity 0 0 0 and the Euler integrator.
The default joint class sets armature 0.004, damping 0.8 and limited true.

The model has seven hinge joints with ranges: r_shoulder_pan -2.2854..1.714602, r_shoulder_lift -0.5236..1.3963, r_upper_arm_roll -1.5..1.7, r_elbow_flex -2.3213..0, r_forearm_roll -1.5..1.5, r_wrist_flex -1.094..0 and r_wrist_roll -1.5..1.5, all in radians.
The actuator block declares seven motor actuators, one per hinge joint, each with ctrllimited true and ctrlrange -1.0..1.0; the shoulder-pan gear is 20 and the other six are 10.
The model declares a target site at position 0.1 0.1 0.1 and a finger site on the wrist-roll body.

determinism.notes: The stand-in repeats the same placeholder integration for the same controls, but it is not MuJoCo and has no seed input; a matching state hash is not a MuJoCo trajectory.

gaps: the fake is a stand-in for the mujoco module, not MuJoCo: it parses the MJCF for nq, nv, nu, the timestep, joint ranges and the seven ctrlranges, but computes no composite inertia, contact, friction, constraint, tendon or sensor physics

each motor's torque (gear * ctrl) accelerates only its own joint against a placeholder unit inertia plus the model's armature; the model's zero gravity is omitted, joint limits are clamped, and this is not MuJoCo's Euler integration
the fake computes no site positions, so the upstream finger/target reward and observation are not reproduced (the family does not serve them)
the stand-in has no mj_getState/mj_setState, so snapshots use the bridge's basic profile (time, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick); warm-start, qacc and derived state are not preserved
no rendering, viewer, contact, sensor or actuator force limit is modelled
the fake was not compared with MuJoCo or with the upstream environment; all integration constants the model does not state are marked placeholder in fake.py

safe_state.description: the simulated world stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the integration state stays readable
